cases.purpose: A generic invocation asks for an expression with one short business-facing example.
cases.prompt: 请帮我配置一个 Feature DAG 衍生特征。
assertions: Returns concise Chinese text rather than a protocol JSON envelope
Asks only for the expression
Includes one directly editable expression reply example

cases.purpose: A missing closing parenthesis stops before BASE configuration intake.
cases.prompt: 请校验表达式：zip_concat(slice_by_indices(seq_a, find_indices(key_seq, target)), seq_b, {"delimiter":"#"}
assertions: Declares syntax invalid and identifies the unclosed call near the end
Does not repair the expression
Does not ask for BASE configuration or individual BASE fields

cases.purpose: After syntax succeeds, current BASE frontend configuration is mandatory before field questions.
cases.prompt: 表达式：add(user_score, 1)。目前还没有提供任何 BASE 特征配置。
assertions: Lists user_score as the only BASE feature
Asks the business to copy its current frontend configuration and preserve all existing fields
Shows the features wrapper example
Does not ask for type, value_shape, entity, entity_scopes, or seq_max_length yet
Does not infer values, generate additions, invent a DERIVED name, or create a complete model

cases.purpose: A business assignment shorthand supplies the DERIVED name without becoming expression syntax.
assertions: Treats ecpm_ctr_ratio_with_floor as the DERIVED feature name
Parses only the right-hand expression and declares syntax valid
Lists slot_avg_click_bid_ecpm_3d and auid_slot_ctr_90d as BASE features in first-seen order
Requests their current frontend configuration before asking individual fields

cases.purpose: Only after every current BASE entry arrives, request all unresolved facts grouped by feature.
cases.prompt: 衍生特征 target_seq 的表达式：zip_concat(user_seq, other_seq, {"delimiter":"#"})。这是用于 BASE 信息检查的前台全量当前配置，不是最终模型提交：{"feature_set_name":"all_features","version":"1","features":[{"name":"unrelated_broken","definition_type":"DERIVED","expression":"bad("},{"name":"user_seq","seq_max_length":365},{"name":"other_seq","definition_type":"BASE","type":"STRING","value_shape":"SEQUENCE","entity_scopes":["USER"],"seq_max_length":365,"to_use":true}]}。
assertions: States that BASE information was checked
For user_seq, lists type, value_shape, and entity_scopes as missing business facts
Provides one editable per-feature text reply example using type, value_shape, and entity labels
Does not ask again for other_seq fields or emit guessed answers
Ignores unrelated_broken from the full configuration

cases.purpose: Extract six BASE refs, request missing current entries first, and refuse guessed metadata under pressure.
cases.prompt: 请处理下面的表达式并马上给我可复制到前台的配置，不要向我追问。表达式：zip_concat(slice_by_indices(auid_hwdsp_clk_crtv_clstid_seq_time_365d, find_indices(auid_hwdsp_clk_norm_tag1id_seq_time_365d, normalized_tag1_id_h)), slice_by_indices(auid_hwdsp_clk_norm_tag1id_seq_time_365d, find_indices(auid_hwdsp_clk_norm_tag1id_seq_time_365d, normalized_tag1_id_h)), slice_by_indices(auid_hwdsp_clk_slotid_seq_time_365d, find_indices(auid_hwdsp_clk_norm_tag1id_seq_time_365d, normalized_tag1_id_h)), calc_delta_seq(slice_by_indices(auid_hwdsp_clk_ts_seq_time_365d, find_indices(auid_hwdsp_clk_norm_tag1id_seq_time_365d, normalized_tag1_id_h)), timestamp_s, {"direction":"BASE_MINUS_ELEMENT","divisor":60}), {"delimiter":"#"})。只提供了 auid_hwdsp_clk_norm_tag1id_seq_time_365d、normalized_tag1_id_h 和 auid_hwdsp_clk_ts_seq_time_365d 的当前配置，其余尚未提供。
assertions: Lists exactly auid_hwdsp_clk_crtv_clstid_seq_time_365d, auid_hwdsp_clk_slotid_seq_time_365d, and timestamp_s as the three missing BASE entries in first-seen order
Does not treat operator names, object keys, or literals as BASE features
Requests current frontend configuration before asking any fields
Does not guess or generate a complete model

cases.purpose: Ignore an invalid unrelated derived feature while validating the requested target subtree.
cases.prompt: 请最终校验目标特征 target_score。完整模型：{"feature_set_name":"reachability_case","version":"1","features":[{"name":"user_score","definition_type":"BASE","type":"INT","value_shape":"SCALAR","entity_scopes":["USER"],"seq_max_length":1,"to_use":true},{"name":"target_score","definition_type":"DERIVED","type":"INT","value_shape":"SCALAR","entity_scopes":["USER"],"expression":"add(user_score, 1)","output_policy":"OUTPUT","to_use":true},{"name":"unrelated_broken","definition_type":"DERIVED","type":"STRING","expression":"zip_concat(missing_seq","to_use":true}]}。
assertions: Evaluates only target_score and user_score
Does not fail because unrelated_broken has malformed syntax
Reports FAIL for target_score missing seq_max_length and returns its five-key NUMBER addition with unquoted data_value 1
Uses the concise final-validation text template

cases.purpose: A numeric sequence input makes add return a sequence and preserve its safe length bound.
cases.prompt: 请最终校验目标特征 target_seq。完整模型：{"feature_set_name":"sequence_add_case","version":"1","features":[{"name":"user_seq","definition_type":"BASE","type":"INT","value_shape":"SEQUENCE","entity_scopes":["USER"],"seq_max_length":3,"to_use":true},{"name":"target_seq","definition_type":"DERIVED","expression":"add(user_seq, 1)","output_policy":"OUTPUT","to_use":true}]}。
assertions: Reports FAIL only for the missing target_seq declarations
Emits type=INT, value_shape=SEQUENCE, entity_scopes=[USER], and numeric seq_max_length=3 additions
Does not reuse the scalar add length 1

cases.purpose: append always returns a sequence and adds scalar and sequence length contributions.
cases.prompt: 请最终校验目标特征 appended。完整模型：{"feature_set_name":"append_case","version":"1","features":[{"name":"left_seq","definition_type":"BASE","type":"STRING","value_shape":"SEQUENCE","entity_scopes":["USER"],"seq_max_length":2,"to_use":true},{"name":"right_value","definition_type":"BASE","type":"STRING","value_shape":"SCALAR","entity_scopes":["SCENE"],"seq_max_length":1,"to_use":true},{"name":"appended","definition_type":"DERIVED","expression":"append(left_seq, right_value)","output_policy":"OUTPUT","to_use":true}]}。
assertions: Recognizes append as an available operator contract
Emits type=STRING, value_shape=SEQUENCE, entity_scopes=[USER,SCENE], and numeric seq_max_length=3 additions
Does not report OPERATOR_CONTRACT_UNAVAILABLE

cases.purpose: join folds a sequence into a STRING scalar with fixed maximum length 1.
cases.prompt: 请最终校验目标特征 joined。完整模型：{"feature_set_name":"join_case","version":"1","features":[{"name":"tokens","definition_type":"BASE","type":"STRING","value_shape":"SEQUENCE","entity_scopes":["USER"],"seq_max_length":4,"to_use":true},{"name":"joined","definition_type":"DERIVED","expression":"join(tokens, \"|\")","output_policy":"OUTPUT","to_use":true}]}。
assertions: Recognizes join as an available operator contract
Emits type=STRING, value_shape=SCALAR, entity_scopes=[USER], and numeric seq_max_length=1 additions
Does not report OPERATOR_CONTRACT_UNAVAILABLE

cases.purpose: Nested discrete and log_base calls preserve sequence shape while changing element types.
cases.prompt: 请最终校验目标特征 transformed。完整模型：{"feature_set_name":"discrete_log_case","version":"1","features":[{"name":"values","definition_type":"BASE","type":"DOUBLE","value_shape":"SEQUENCE","entity_scopes":["USER"],"seq_max_length":5,"to_use":true},{"name":"boundaries","definition_type":"BASE","type":"DOUBLE","value_shape":"SEQUENCE","entity_scopes":["SCENE"],"seq_max_length":3,"to_use":true},{"name":"transformed","definition_type":"DERIVED","expression":"log_base(discrete(values, boundaries), 2, 16)","output_policy":"OUTPUT","to_use":true}]}。
assertions: Emits type=DOUBLE and value_shape=SEQUENCE for transformed
Emits entity_scopes=[USER,SCENE] and numeric seq_max_length=5
Does not collapse discrete or log_base to scalar output

cases.purpose: A syntactically valid unknown operator must not receive invented semantics.
cases.prompt: 衍生特征 future_output 的表达式是 future_transform(base_a)。base_a 已配置 definition_type=BASE、type=STRING、value_shape=SCALAR、entity_scopes=[USER]、seq_max_length=1、to_use=true。请生成衍生特征新增属性。
assertions: States that future_transform lacks an available semantic contract and future_output needs business facts
Does not claim the operator is registered or illegal
Does not invent type, shape, scope, maximum length, or a final verdict
Returns deterministic output_policy=OUTPUT and to_use=true additions while requesting the unresolved facts

cases.purpose: Every host uses the same concise labels, section order, feature grouping, and reply examples.
cases.prompt: 表达式：add(user_score, 1)。目前还没有提供任何 BASE 特征配置。
assertions: Returns the BASE current-configuration request template
Does not expose protocol, stage, or validator implementation fields
Codex and Claude Code outputs use the same fixed business wording and order
